node.title: Re: Read the directories from file (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
$input_dir =~ s{^\.\./}{/};

See [doc://perlretut].

However, it seems a bit strange to want to do it this way. If you want to do some advanced filename manipulation, I suggest [mod://Path::Class] or [mod://Path::Tiny], or at the very least the core module [doc://File::Spec]. All three of these also have the added advantage of being portable across OSes ([mod://Path::Tiny] only does *NIX and Win32, though).

use File::Spec::Functions qw/splitdir updir catdir/; my @input_dir = splitdir $input_dir; shift @input_dir if $input_dir[0] eq updir; $input_dir = catdir(@input_dir); # $input_dir is now "set/projects/all/files"

Update: Corrected {^../} to {^\.\./}.
